reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code are the first thing I have seen that answers my 'is it really tested' question, and the empty-box refund makes one box at $24.99 a low-risk try. I would grab it from a creator video that hits my sleep problem.
objection: Made in China and I already have a drawer of half-used bottles, so I worry I will take it for a week and forget it. I would also want to actually open the report and see it is real.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR code led to a generic page or a report that did not match the batch number on the box, I would not buy.
